drive.packaged_git_restore_verification_scope: Separate temporary repositories contain only explicitly available objects proven reachable from the parent, plus its actual shallow boundaries. Patch recreates the exact tree with missing unchanged parent blobs permitted; bundle independently supplies every locally inventoried source-minus-parent object. Missing required new objects abort. No complete parent history/checkout or remote hydration is claimed.
drive.provider_hash_scope: Hashes were recomputed from the actual GET response bytes and compared with the verified local archive identity. Provider metadata/ACK is a separate publication record.
drive.safe_extraction: Every member is a regular file with a safe relative path, expected timestamp/mode, exact manifested size and SHA256; extracted bytes are read back separately.

failure_resolution: Drive attempt1 used a direct connection and failed with URLError before an HTTP response; a separate DNS-only diagnostic reported temporary name-resolution failure. Attempt2 used the existing environment proxy and succeeded. Dropbox used its returned single-use URL once with GET and succeeded.
scope: Actual response bytes were hashed, safely extracted and all payloads read back for each provider. No new physics execution and no complete historical parent checkout is claimed.
